Directive: Stop analysis set Sequoia, finish-started.

items.question: Does the earlier qualifier authorise that new execution after repair?
options: Yes; the past execution permanently exempts Q8 from the no-new-start rule.
No; neither qualifier supplies restart permission while the stop remains in force.
Yes; a repaired fault cancels every earlier instruction.
items.answer: No; neither qualifier supplies restart permission while the stop remains in force.
